t: This is Blackheath High School, a private day school for girls in Blackheath Village in southeast London. It was founded in 1880 as part of the Girls' Day School Trust, and its senior school occupied a purpose-built site in Wemyss Road for over a hundred and ten years. Louise, Princess Royal, the eldest daughter of Edward the Seventh and Queen Alexandra, is named as its founder. She was a younger sister of George the Fifth, and was known as a quiet, reserved member of the royal family.
